clinical_justification: The patient has a primary diagnosis of dependent drug abuse (SNOMED CT 6525002) with a long‑standing history since 2011, indicating chronic substance dependence. Inpatient drug rehabilitation and detoxification is required to safely manage withdrawal symptoms, prevent complications, and provide supervised medical and psychosocial support that cannot be delivered on an outpatient basis. A planned five‑day inpatient stay aligns with standard detoxification protocols for severe dependence, establishing the medical necessity of admission.
